source.dataset: Small Area Income and Poverty Estimates (SAIPE)

howToRead: Model-based single-year estimates that combine survey data with tax and program records, so even small counties get a yearly number.
title: Median household income by county
description: Income of the household in the middle of each county.
caveats: Not adjusted for inflation between years, or for local cost of living.
Connecticut replaced its counties with planning regions in 2022, so it appears as no data on the county map.
